title: Minotaur vs Mage Battle
description: A purple muscular minotaur with blue hair and horns rampages through ancient ruins, smashing stone pillars as chains fly around it. In the foreground, a hooded mage in purple and white robes leaps through the air, dual-wielding a glowing purple pistol and a bright turquoise magical shield while casting spells amid flying debris.
